Demo catalog. Specs relayed from web search summaries on 2026-09-08, then the product page was read by Codex on 2026-09-09 at 15:40 Pacific. The page describes a reimagined Original with a Pro Chiller Gen2 included, and this record is now scoped to that page wherever the page supports the figure. Seven figures agree exactly between the older relayed material and the reading, so each stands whichever model the summary meant: 66-5/8 by 31-1/2 by 26 in, 144 lb empty, 105 gallons, an 80 in maximum user height and 37°F, with a chiller included and a one-year term. Insulation, indoor and outdoor placement and app temperature control are read from this page. What the reading does not cover is not promoted: the sanitation and power claims stay as history, marked, and score nothing, and the older warranty wording is recorded as wording rather than as a read term. The price and whether this tub heats both turn on a configuration nobody has matched, and both are left unresolved. Stock, images and any health claim remain unverified.
